Chapter 174 Reconcile

The night of Xinzheng City is famous all over the world. As one of the few famous cities in the Central Plains, it goes without saying that it is prosperous. Even at night, there are still several night markets open, and the hustle and bustle continues the bustle of the day.

Sitting in his own carriage, Zhong Yu opened the window from time to time, watching the passers-by on both sides, and had another evaluation of South Korea's strength in his heart.

"Although South Korea is the weakest of the Warring States, its capital is comparable to other powerful countries, and even better in some respects!" Zhong Yu said, following Zhao Yun and others who were accompanying him.

"Your Highness is right. I heard that Xinzheng City has a population of 300,000, accounting for nearly half of the population of South Korea. The essence of the whole country is concentrated here, so it is naturally very prosperous!" The scene is full of bones exposed in the wild, there is no rooster crowing for thousands of miles, and wild shops can be seen everywhere in deserted villages. Zhao Yun is also a little emotional.

"That's right, the prosperity of this South Korea is much better than that of my previous capitals. Although the population is small, its prosperity is not comparable to that of my previous capitals!" For this technologically advanced world, Zhong Yu can only sigh, his former backward capital, compared to the capital of this small country in South Korea, is like the difference between feudalism and modern times.

"It's true, this world is indeed very strange, and many things are far from what Yuguo used to be!" Zhao Yun was also fascinated by the magic of this world.

During the conversation between the few people, time seemed to flow like running water, and the carriage passed by in the blink of an eye, but the carriage had already reached the gate of the palace.

In the royal palace at this time, there were already several people waiting outside the gate, which was just opened, but King Han did not appear again. Han Wang's greeting during the day before, the Korean etiquette that has been exhausted, appeared again, and he lost his Korean identity.

"Lord Prime Minister, I haven't seen you for a few hours, the lonely king really misses it very much!" Ten meters away, Zhong Yu spoke before he opened his mouth.

"Where, His Highness Prince Jing's virtues are what make people fascinated!" Being greeted with a smiling face, he would naturally not speak ill of him with his open face, not to mention, it is his duty to entertain the person in front of him happily.

When they got closer, the two exchanged pleasantries again, and then opened their mouths to express the difficulties that King Han could not come to greet him, but Zhong Yu generously expressed his indifference.

Then hello, hello, hello everyone.

Everyone laughed all the way to the palace of the palace, ready to go to this banquet.

...

In the palace, it was the time of celebration and rising. Everyone toasted and staggered. They had already drank several cups while laughing and laughing, but they still didn't realize it.

"His Royal Highness Prince Jing, it's an honor for you to come to this banquet. You and I will have a drink together!" King Han raised his wine glass and said to Zhong Yuyao.

"It's an honor for the lonely king to be able to attend the king's banquet!" Zhong Yu also raised his wine glass high, pointed slightly at King Han, and drank the wine in the glass.

"Okay, happy, Your Highness is really refreshing!" Haha laughed a few times, and King Han also drank it all in one gulp.

...

I don't know how long it took, all the people who came to the banquet dispersed, and in the main hall, only King Han and his several important officials were left.

"Your Majesty, I don't know what you think of this Prince Jing after your investigation?" Zhang Kaidi spoke first, and asked his Majesty.

"Gu Wang thinks that this Prince Jing is not as inaccessible as the rumors say. Although there are some hypocrisy in the words, as a superior, it is also what it should be. It is not surprising!" Han Wang hesitated. All of a sudden, he slowly expressed his uncertain guess.

"Through the past few days of contact, I have been observing continuously all the way, and I also found that although this Prince Jing is a bit arrogant, he is not so difficult to get in touch with. As long as you can match his temperament, you can say a lot of things!" Hearing When King Han opened his mouth, he opened his heart with a little bit of confirmation, and he also expressed his own observations.

"Since the king and the prime minister both regard it this way, then this Prince Jing's character should be about the same, you can believe it." Ji Wuye said with a sullen face, and the two agreed, because his observations were similar to theirs. .

However, at this moment, in his heart, he probably wished he could go back immediately, kill those spies who told him that King Jing was not easy to contact, and spoil his own affairs, so he pushed this golden opportunity to Zhang with his own hands. Open up this own political enemy.

"I don't know if the general thinks that the strategy of uniting the imperialists against Qin will work!" Looking at the stinky general Ji Midnight, who has been drinking alone since the beginning of the banquet, the prime minister opened his mouth and showed a rare smile. , asked jokingly.

"We can do things about the alliance. Although I didn't have much contact with Prince Jing just now, I made some tentative remarks in the few times I spoke. Judging from the attitude expressed by this Prince Jing, he has a great deal of respect for the state of Qin. The opinion is not very good, it can even be said to be extremely bad!" Ji Wuye said very depressed.

Although he really wanted to get closer, he slapped Zou Baba's stinky face which made him feel disgusted. But Ji Wuye hadn't forgotten her identity and where her power came from, and she didn't neglect her.

"Gu Wang also tried a few times, and found that this King Jing really has the intention of joining forces, and also represents a certain meaning of imperial power!" Speaking of this, he found out, and King Han became excited. Isn't that what he thought?

"I have been traveling all the way, and I have also observed the views of those accompanying the Yu Kingdom towards the Qin Kingdom. There is a bit of disgust in the disdain, and there is obvious hostility." There is a hint of excitement in the tone, and I openly recall what I have been on the way. See.

"That's great. It seems that not only King Jing is like this, but also other people in the Yu Kingdom. There will be a battle between Qin and Yu, and then the alliance that I and Korea are seeking will definitely come true!" Seeing Zhang Kaidi's answer, Han Wang was even more excited, as if he saw that after he united with the imperial kingdom, he didn't have to worry about Qin's offense.

"Since this is the case, we must leave a good impression on King Jing's mind these days. He is an important person who determines whether the Han and Yu countries can form an alliance!" Thinking of King Jing's power in Yuguo, Ji Wuye Open your mouth and say.

"The general is right. According to the news I have received in the past few days, this Prince Jing is a very important person in Yuguo. Many important decisions in the country are made by him. He is a person who can influence the emperor of Yuguo. A person of will!" It was rare that this time, Zhang Kai actually agreed with Ji Wuye's words.

"In that case, Prime Minister, since you have established a good relationship with Prince Jing, then you will be in charge of Prince Jing's affairs in South Korea, and you must be considerate!" With jealous eyes, Han Wang said these words.
